title: Mechanism numbers drifted: legionella 7 vs 10 days, input age 60 vs 360 min, pump-duty echo grace 60 vs 20 s
claim: Of 57 numbers stated in the mechanism paragraphs of README.md, how-it-works.md and configuration.md, 7 differ from the value the shipped code uses: the anti-legionella interval is '7 days' in README.md:506, how-it-works.md:622 and configuration.md:287 and :478 against const.DEFAULT_DHW_LEGIONELLA_INTERVAL_DAYS = ThermalParameters().dhw_legionella_interval_days = 10.0; how-it-works.md:1004 gives '60 minutes for indoor and tank temperatures' against const.INPUT_MAX_AGE_MINUTES = 360 for both; and configuration.md:900-901 says pump-duty readings 'in the first 60 seconds after a write are not counted' against pump_arbiter.ECHO_GRACE_S = 20.0, the grace pump_arbiter._edited applies.
mechanism: Each number moved in code (the input age to six hours for report-on-change probes, D1-s5-51 per its comment; the legionella interval to 10 days; the arbiter's echo grace to 20 s, 'past the fork's 8 s sent-value window') while the prose kept the old value; no gate pins these numbers against the documents. configuration.md's other 107 comparable table defaults and all 79 ranges agree (defaults_table.py), as do 50 other prose numbers, including 21 Pump duty control numbers. A user relying on the documented weekly disinfection gets a 10-day cycle; one reading the staleness section expects a dead probe to freeze the learners after an hour, not six; one reading the hold rule expects an edit within a minute of a write to be ignored, while the arbiter adopts it after 20 s.

evidence.contention_note: box heavily loaded (load1 200-280); counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb-code (legionella default 7.0), --perturb-age (indoor and tank ages 60), --perturb-echo (ECHO_GRACE_S 60.0), --perturb-doc (four units to 10 days), each in memory

null_control.value: 50 other stated numbers agree (legionella temperature, wind, rain, DHW minimum, cooling rate, inlet, two-zone set, outdoor and power-meter ages, cop_scale bounds, outage gap and delay, away DHW minimum, mixed-use reference, disinfection hold, elastic minimum, interval, comfort weight, and the Pump duty control flow ceiling/hold/gates, return spread, lift, feedback start/rate/window/deadband/floor, duty-switch stop window/count/half-life, rails, boost hours, retry, ledger tank rise); defaults_table.py: 1 mismatch (legionella) of 108 table defaults, 0 of 79 ranges
null_control.note: the comparison separates the moved defaults from the many that agree

metric_definition: Doc (unit, number) pairs whose stated value differs from the production value (ThermalParameters field, const, or module constant), over 57 pairs.
phenomenon_property: Every default or mechanism number a reader document states equals the value the shipped code uses.
proposed_fix_scope: Make the four legionella units and const.DEFAULT_DHW_LEGIONELLA_INTERVAL_DAYS agree (the owner's call which value is intended), and rewrite how-it-works.md:1004 to six hours for indoor, floor and tank probes with the reason (report-on-change probes). A doc_claims.py arm pinning documented defaults to const closes the class. For D6: the same sentences. Rewrite configuration.md:900-902 to the 20 s grace (past the Tuya fork's 8 s echo).
